description: TuneOps org-level Renovate preset. Encodes the policy from tuneops-docs/workspace/design/RENOVATE_POLICY.md (Phase 0 decisions D1-D3) and the versioning tiers from tuneops-workspace/.claude/rules/versioning-policy.md (F-09cb6). Consumed by every tuneops-ai repo via `extends: ["github>tuneops-ai/.github:renovate-config"]`. B-9260e revival (CEO 2026-11-10): Renovate opens PRs and merges nothing; third-party dependencies only — github.com/tuneops-ai/** belongs to the Go bump bot (deps/tuneops-bump).

packageRules.description: Phase C Stage 1 — Dashboard mode. Every detected update lands as a checkbox on the Dependency Dashboard issue first. PRs only open when the box is checked. To flip a repo to PR mode (Stage 2), override `dependencyDashboardApproval: false` in that repo's renovate.json.

B-9260e: TuneOps internal Go modules belong to the Go bump bot (reusable-go-dependency-bump, rolling deps/tuneops-bump PR, C-a09ae). Renovate ignores them so the two never open duplicate PRs. Supersedes the CHORE-460f7 Stage-2a rules.
Security advisories — the PR opens off-schedule with no dashboard approval (CVE response time matters). B-9260e: it does NOT auto-merge; a session merges it on green through the AtTune merge gates.

B-9260e: no rule may merge. External patch/pin/digest updates were auto-merged on green (RENOVATE_POLICY.md D2); revisit after ~2 weeks of observed green PRs, and give merge-on-green to Mergify (F-82ef5 AC-9), one automerger.
